=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k3 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:lines 3043-3051 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: None of the three new tests exercises this fallback branch. The preflight fixture test (tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py test_review_preflight_missing_opencode_binary_emits_classified_error) copies the real opencode_helpers.sh into the support dir, so only the primary `opencode_emit_failure_alert` path runs for binary_missing. The helpers_missing / config_writer_missing calls at lines 3100 and 3103 — which are the only workflow-side paths that build the payload by hand — are never executed, so a format drift between the hand-built payload (line 3043) and the canonical helper payload (scripts/opencode_helpers.sh:118) would go undetected.
  WHY: No runtime failure today; the strings currently match byte-for-byte. The gap is that the branch implementing required change #1 for the helpers-missing case has no execution coverage, so a future edit to only one of the two payload formats would silently break the stable-line contract that workflow-log analysis greps for. Extending the preflight test with a second fixture run that omits opencode_helpers.sh (asserting the helpers_missing alert line + Telegram capture) closes it in a few lines.
- changelog.d/opencode-bootstrap-stable-alert.md:the filename itself | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fragment filename omits the issue/PR number prefix required by the documented convention `changelog.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md`. This work belongs to issue #3870, so the conventional name is changelog.d/3870-opencode-bootstrap-stable-alert.md.
  WHY: No runtime failure — scripts/assemble_changelog.py (lines 120-134) folds any `*.md` in changelog.d/ regardless of prefix, so the entry will assemble correctly. The break is in the documented per-PR traceability/uniqueness contract the directory relies on; non-prefixed names also collide more easily across PRs picking the same slug, which is the exact failure mode the prefix rule exists to prevent.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k3 ===
